title: ui-orchestrator-checkpoint
description: UI orchestrator checkpoint for resumable execution

mode.description: Current execution mode. Updated to new mode on mode switch; previous_mode retains original mode for reference

previous_mode.description: Execution mode before switch (exists only on mode switch, e.g., prototype->full)

completed_stages.description: List of successfully completed stage IDs (e.g., ['stage-1', 'stage-2'])

stage_outputs.description: Output file paths for each completed stage; key is stage ID, value is output path

ext_enhancement_applied.description: ext stage execution status; key is stage ID, value is summary of ext Skill invocation results for that stage

stage-1.description: Design system establishment results (including conditional branches: design exploration/PM constraint review)

stage-3.description: Page & component construction results (including design_feedback propagation status)
